subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should maintainers continue with the existing open Control UI preview PR, or sponsor a narrow replacement that implements the same UX on current `ui/src/pages/sessions/*` code?
rationale: The feature is aligned and small, but the current linked branch is stale/proof-needed and maintainers need to choose whether to repair that contributor branch or replace it before automation should queue new work.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 as the implementation path and ask for the `lastMessagePreview` field fix, current-main rebase, tests, and real UI proof.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the linked PR and have a maintainer-backed branch implement the same bounded preview using current Control UI files.

options.title: Defer to broader sessions workspace
options.body: Hold this narrow UX until the larger session-overview product direction in related issues is decided.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 as the implementation path and ask for the `lastMessagePreview` field fix, current-main rebase, tests, and real UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the existing preview contract and recent adjacent session-management work, making them the best available decision owner from the history trail.
